snippet.title: Beerland - RZX Playback
snippet.description:
Beerland
1991 - Proxima Software (Czech)
ZX-Spectrum 48K - Adventure Game: Text-Only

Recorded by Pavel Plíva (with rollback)

More info here: https://spectrumcomputing.co.uk/entry/499/ZX-Spectrum/Beerland

We are most grateful to the late Daren Pearcy for all his work in popularising the RZX format. Without his work this project would not have been possible.
